faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for ICAR IARI Research Associate-III / Senior Research Fellow posts?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the application form for the ICAR IARI recruitment is 06 September 2026. Candidates must ensure their applications reach the specified address by this deadline.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available in the ICAR IARI recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are a total of 2 vacancies announced for the Research Associate-III / Senior Research Fellow positions at ICAR-Indian Agricultural Research Institute.

faq.question: Q3. What is the application mode for these ICAR IARI posts?
faq.answer: The application mode for the Research Associate-III / Senior Research Fellow posts at ICAR IARI is offline. Candidates need to download, fill, and send the application form.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for ICAR IARI Research Associate-III / Senior Research Fellow positions?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for applicants for these posts is 40 years. Age relaxation is applicable for SC/ST/OBC-NCL/PwBD/Ex-Servicemen/Women candidates as per Government of India rules.

faq.question: Q5. What are the educational qualifications required for these posts?
faq.answer: Candidates should have a Ph.D. in Microbiology / Biotechnology / Life Sciences or a Master's degree in Microbiology / Life Sciences / Biotechnology with relevant experience and qualifications as per post requirements.

faq.question: Q6. Is there any application fee for the ICAR IARI recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for the ICAR IARI Research Associate-III / Senior Research Fellow recruitment.

faq.question: Q7. What is the salary for Research Associate - III at ICAR IARI?
faq.answer: The salary for the Research Associate - III position is Rs. 67,000 per month plus 27% HRA, as per the official notification.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process for ICAR IARI Research Associate-III / Senior Research Fellow?
faq.answer: The selection process involves screening based on qualifications, followed by a merit list, and finally an interview in a 1:10 ratio.

faq.question: Q9. Where is the job location for these ICAR IARI vacancies?
faq.answer: The job location for the Research Associate-III / Senior Research Fellow posts is New Delhi, Delhi, with the pincode 110012.

faq.question: Q10. When will shortlisted candidates be intimated for the interview?
faq.answer: Shortlisted candidates will be intimated by email or phone on 14 September 2026, as per the important dates mentioned in the notification.
